# Table

Table. Rows of data. Row height is a scheme decision (situation table-row): compact in Dense data, comfortable or large elsewhere. Numbers use the data text role so columns align where the scheme answers typography.roles with a data role. Reads only component keys: --table-\*.

See it in [Storybook](http://localhost:6006) under Components / Table, in every theme.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-`.

| Key | What it controls | Reads | light | dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `table/header-background` | Header row fill. | `color.surface.sunken` | #EEF1F5 | #262D38 |
| `table/row-height` | Height of one data row. | `size.row` | 2rem (32px) | 2rem (32px) |
| `table/cell-padding-x` | Horizontal padding inside a cell. | `space.inset.cell-x` | 0.75rem (12px) | 0.75rem (12px) |
| `table/row-border` | Line between rows. | `color.border.default` | #DDE2EA | #262D38 |
| `table/row-selected` | Fill of a selected row. | `color.surface.selected` | #E6EDFC | #163784 |
| `table/font-size` | Cell text size. | `type.data.font-size` | 0.8125rem (13px) | 0.8125rem (13px) |

## When to use it

| Situation | Use | Not | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| An empty state | Why it is empty and the one action that fills it | A blank table | An empty table with no words looks like an error. Example: “No late orders. Change the date range to see older ones.” |
